objective_summary.value: The investigation aimed to quantify liquid smoke droplet sizes in microgravity and relate droplet size distribution to smoke generation and transport conditions. It also sought to develop a numerical model predicting smoke droplet growth based on pyrolysis rate, vapor properties, and flow environment.
objective_summary.quote: One of the major goals of this investigation was to quantify the sizes that the liquid smoke particulate achieves in low gravity and to relate the droplet size distribution to the smoke generation and smoke transport conditions in the experiment.

earth_applications.value: Smoke detectors developed from the results can be used in extreme environments on Earth, such as submarines or underwater laboratories, saving lives through accurate smoke detection.
earth_applications.quote: The smoke detectors developed from the results of SAME can also be useful in other extreme environments on Earth, such as submarines or underwater laboratories.
